boundary: Repository-local synthetic pilot material. These objects support bounded symbolic analysis only and do not establish external facts, truth, legitimacy, popularity, ownership, naming authority, or causality.

objects.description: A repository-local representation of a shared football field, its access boundary, schedule, and named uses.
The council actor that controls booking and official naming in the pilot.
The player-group actor that uses the field in the pilot.
The neighbouring-resident actor that bears noise and access costs in the pilot.
Repository-local pilot observations of booking windows, fence access, scheduled use, and reported noise; not external verification.
Bounded actor-attributed interpretations of stewardship, belonging, and exclusion.
Repository-local record of access control and naming authority in the pilot.
Distinct front-face community narrative and suppressed-face cost narrative attributed to different actor positions.
Repository-local allocation record naming beneficiaries, cost bearers, and the bounded effects attributed to each.
Evidence for a counter-reading that the official belonging narrative obscures unequal access and cost.
A repository-local representation of a school data policy, collection fields, access roles, and retention rules.
The school-administration actor that adopts and names the policy in the pilot.
The student actor whose data is collected and classified in the pilot.
The family actor that receives notices and bears review and correction costs in the pilot.
Repository-local pilot observations of declared collection fields, role access, retention, and correction procedure; not external verification.
Bounded actor-attributed interpretations of safety, classification, oversight, and loss of agency.
Repository-local record of institutional authority, naming authority, and information control in the pilot.
Distinct front-face safety narrative and suppressed-face classification-cost narrative attributed to different actor positions.
Repository-local allocation record naming institutional beneficiaries, affected students and families, and their bounded costs.
Evidence for a counter-reading that a safety label does not itself establish proportionality, accuracy, or truth.
